description: This PHP source file defines the InstanceCreationHelper class within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides static constants and methods related to geographical, linguistic, and timezone data used during system installation or configuration. It includes country, language, and timezone lists and utility methods for retrieving specific data entries.

classes.name: InstanceCreationHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static data sets and methods for retrieving country, language, and timezone information pertinent to the installation process of the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getTimezones
methods.description: Returns an array of all available timezone identifiers with their labels.

methods.name: getCountryByCode
methods.description: Returns the country data object matching the provided country code.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Returns the language data object matching the provided language code.
